jamb-physics-mock-0002.explanation: g ≈ 9.8 m/s² near the Earth's surface.

jamb-physics-mock-0004.explanation: Constant velocity means no change in velocity, hence zero acceleration.

jamb-physics-mock-0007.explanation: Sound is mechanical and needs a material medium; a vacuum has none.

jamb-physics-mock-0008.explanation: Power is measured in watts; 1 W = 1 J/s.

jamb-physics-mock-0009.explanation: Power = work done per unit time.

jamb-physics-mock-0010.explanation: A concave mirror converges parallel rays to a focus.

jamb-physics-mock-0012.explanation: Velocity has both magnitude and direction; the others are scalars.

jamb-physics-mock-0013.explanation: A generator (dynamo) converts mechanical energy to electrical energy; a motor does the reverse.

jamb-physics-mock-0015.explanation: Refraction is caused by the change in the speed of light between media of different optical densities.
